tree.heading: General rule
tree.text: The Secretary shall include environmental protection as one of the primary missions of the Corps of Engineers in planning, designing, constructing, operating, and maintaining water resources projects.

children.text: existing Corps of Engineers’ authorities, including its authorities with respect to navigation and flood control;
pending Corps of Engineers permit applications or pending lawsuits involving permits or water resources projects; or
the application of public interest review procedures for Corps of Engineers permits.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 1990, and not as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 1986 which comprises this chapter.

notes.heading: “Secretary” Defined
notes.text: Secretary means the Secretary of the Army, see section 2 of Pub. L. 101–640, set out as a note under section 2201 of this title.
